name: AI WP Site Manager
changelog:
1.15.0

  • GET/POST ai-wp/v1/seo-meta/<id>: read and set the SEO title, meta description, canonical URL and noindex of one post or page, for Yoast SEO or Rank Math (whichever is active). Only the fields sent are changed, an empty string clears a field, noindex null returns to the site default. Yoast's indexable is rebuilt at once, so the new description is served without re-saving the page; the page cache of that post is purged. Needs edit_post on that post; 409 when no SEO plugin is active.
